title: Item Teleporter
description: A server utility plugin that lets players set a personal destination (/settp) and instantly teleport a single, custom item—the Teleport Beacon—when it is dropped into any Chest.
body:
# 📦 Item Teleporter: Server Utility Plugin

The **Item Teleporter** plugin gives your players an easy, no-fuss way to route specific items across your Minecraft world using a simple "drop-off" chest system. Say goodbye to complex redstone or laggy hopper networks for your special deliveries!

## ✨ Features

* **Simple Destination Setting:** Use one command to set your personal teleport drop-off point.
* **Custom Teleport Beacon:** Introduces a custom **Teleport Beacon (Ender Pearl)** item with unique lore. Only this item, when dropped into a chest, will be teleported.
* **Safe & Instant Transport:** The item is instantly and safely delivered to your set destination point, making it perfect for high-value goods or a single, special farm drop.
* **Lightweight & Efficient:** Designed to be a simple, single-purpose utility that won't strain your server resources.

## ⚙️ How to Use

1.  **Set Your Destination:** Stand at the block where you want the item to arrive (e.g., the top of a storage container).
    * **Command:** `/settp`
2.  **Get the Beacon:** Get the special **Teleport Beacon** item.
    * *This will be crafted or acquired by a server admin.*
3.  **Initiate Transport:** Drop the **Teleport Beacon** item into any standard **Chest**.
4.  **Instant Delivery!** The item is immediately removed from the chest and appears at your saved `/settp` location.
